zones.name: Recovery
zones.feel: Truly easy. If you have to think about the effort, it's too hard.

zones.name: Endurance
zones.feel: Bulk of your riding. Conversation pace, RPE 3-4. Long-ride target 150-190 W. After 2 h the ceiling drops about 10%, so go by feel.

zones.name: Tempo
zones.feel: Sustained, controlled breathing, RPE 5-6 (about 80-90% of 275 W).

zones.name: Threshold and above
zones.feel: From about 250 W up. Threshold and VO2max efforts, coached by cue rather than fixed watts.

block.name: Base 1
block.focus: restart and routine, baseline FTP, running and swim technique, kettlebell habit

workouts.title: Restart ride, 75 min easy
workouts.purpose: Restart the routine gently after bad sleep and with a sore left calf. Today is about checking how the calf and legs feel.

steps.target: Ease in, under 150 W, RPE 2, chat pace
150-190 W, RPE 3-4, steady, cadence 85-95
Cool-down, easy spinning

workouts.cue: Slept badly again? Cut it to 45 minutes. Nothing today needs to be hard. Rate your left calf 0-10 afterwards: above 4, or a changed pedal stroke, means stop and ease off.

fuel.before: As soon as you wake (30-45 min before the ride): 1 banana + 1 slice of bread with Nutella, or a gel with water. Don't ride on an empty stomach.
fuel.after: Within 2 hours: a proper meal with 25-40 g protein plus carbs (see meals). Banana milk is a good first drink.

workouts.title: Kettlebell, 20 min (technique)
workouts.purpose: Build kettlebell technique first. Strength for durability, with the habit before the load.

steps.target: Warm-up: hip-hinge drill, glute bridge 10, arm circles, cat-cow
Two-hand swing with the 16 kg bell: 5 sets of 10, rest 60 s. The hips do the work, arms just hang on
Goblet squat: 3 sets of 8, slow on the way down
Plank: 2 x 30 s

workouts.cue: Swings are a hip hinge, not a squat. Back flat. If your lower back complains, stop and tell me.

fuel.before: A small carb snack 1-2 hours before (banana or a slice of bread).
fuel.after: 25-40 g protein within 2 hours, banana milk or yoghurt works.

workouts.title: Rest day (travel home)
workouts.purpose: Rest before the first weekend of the plan. No ride home yet: the base, the calf and the sleep need a few weeks first.
workouts.cue: Train home. Eat normally. Aim to be in bed before midnight.
